title: Zaffer has a Proposition

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Alright pal? You get that neon for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright pal? You get that neon for me?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: You're top class, you know that? Leave it with me, I'll zaff ya something nice. Get your old place looking bright again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're top class, you know that? Leave it with me, I'll zaff ya something nice. Get your old place looking bright again.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Can you hear yourself? What's a little rule-bending among friends, eh? We are friends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you hear yourself? What's a little rule-bending among friends, eh? We are friends?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Eh, what're friends for? We are friends?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, what're friends for? We are friends?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Then neither will I. Thanks for the neons, pal. I'll put them to good use - somewhere else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then neither will I. Thanks for the neons, pal. I'll put them to good use - somewhere else.
Maybe more than...?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: So how about stepping out with me sometime?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So how about stepping out with me sometime?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: The feeling's mutual, pal. And hey, thanks for the neons. I'll zaff ya something real nice. Promise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The feeling's mutual, pal. And hey, thanks for the neons. I'll zaff ya something real nice. Promise.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Yeah. Why? ‘Fraid to be seen with the city's most wanted art punk?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. Why? ‘Fraid to be seen with the city's most wanted art punk?
So do you.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: That you’re a Corpo flirt, but punk where it counts. So, how about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That you’re a Corpo flirt, but punk where it counts. So, how about it?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: That you're as punk as the rest of us. So, how about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That you're as punk as the rest of us. So, how about it?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: So, you'll come out with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, you'll come out with me?

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: You will? Sweet! I mean, that’s cool, pal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will? Sweet! I mean, that’s cool, pal.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: It's... a surprise. I’ll send Ava the info.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's... a surprise. I’ll send Ava the info.

nodes.speaker: Zaffer
nodes.text: Illegal? I’m wounded. You’ll have to see for yourself, won’t you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Illegal? I’m wounded. You’ll have to see for yourself, won’t you?
Zaff ya then.
I’ll send Ava the info.
Sure did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're not going to use it for anything illegal, are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not going to use it for anything illegal, are you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're not going to use it for anything illegal, are you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're not going to use it for anything illegal, are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Definitely.
I wouldn't go that far.
Can't wait.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If "more" means good friends, then yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If "more" means good friends, then yes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If "more" means good friends, then yes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If "more" means good friends, then yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe...
Like on a date?
Never.
You do have a reputation...
What's my reputation?
I will.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, I'll go out with you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, I'll go out with you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright, I'll go out with you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright, I'll go out with you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So where do you want to go?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So where do you want to go?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So where do you want to go?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So where do you want to go?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let me guess: it's somewhere illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me guess: it's somewhere illegal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let me guess: it's somewhere illegal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let me guess: it's somewhere illegal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be there.
Totally cool!
